title: Blinking Bookworm Blenny
statement: Resting among sunken brass spectacles, stacked slate ledges, and swaying olive-green ferns in warm, amber-filtered light, this tiny, wide-eyed blenny spends its days sorting iridescent sea-glass pebbles by hue. Known for its rapid, thoughtful blinking, it peers curiously through the glass at visitors as though trying to read the world's smallest footnotes.
